drafter.private_reasoning: The settlement amount, payment deadline, represented party, and settlement authority are unspecified. Preserve confidentiality and avoid inferring authority or disclosing privileged litigation assessments. Propose neutral mechanics subject to client approval.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Counsel, attached are proposed clarifications to the payment, release, and confidentiality provisions, subject to client approval. The settlement amount and payment deadline remain open for agreement. Please confirm the parties’ full legal names and whether any pending action requires a dismissal provision.

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff [SETTLEMENT AMOUNT] by [PAYMENT DEADLINE], using payment instructions separately confirmed by the parties through a verified channel. The amount and deadline remain subject to express agreement by the parties.

2. RELEASE. Effective only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from claims arising out of the dispute described in the Recitals that accrued on or before the effective date of this Agreement. This release does not apply to obligations under this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this settlement confidential, except for disclosures to their legal and tax advisers, disclosures required by law or court order, and disclosures reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. Before a compelled disclosure, the disclosing party shall, to the extent legally permitted and reasonably practicable, give the other party notice and an opportunity to seek protective treatment.
